text.offer: Morrigan says, "The treefolk of Faronath bring me herbs for the kitchen, but lately they hardly dare leave home. The spiders of the Forest of Farol have grown bold, as if something is driving them out of the deep wood. Kill ten of them and the treefolk might come back to market."
text.progress: The Forest of Farol lies west of Marion; Faronath is in its heart.
text.complete: Morrigan says, "The treefolk will be glad of it. And if you are wondering where the road goes next: Ran er'Hoth has been looking for someone to carry word of all this to Cor Noth. Speak to him once you feel ready for the journey."
